result.summary: Fixes a unit test in miner_tests by setting the prevout index to 0 for a test transaction in TestBasicMining. Previously, the test reused a transaction whose prevout was reset with SetNull(), leaving the output index as NULL_INDEX. This change ensures the first transaction spends a valid output so the test properly validates failure due to a double spend rather than a nonexistent input.
result.problem: The double spend case in TestBasicMining attempted to test that block template creation fails when two mempool transactions double-spend an output. However, because prevout index was left as NULL_INDEX, block template creation was failing prematurely due to an invalid input rather than because of the conflicting spend.
evidence: PR description: 'The double spend case in TestBasicMining is meant to check that block template creation fails when two mempool transactions spend the same coin... The output index therefore stays COutPoint::NULL_INDEX, so both transactions spend an output of txFirst[0] that does not exist.'

Commit b2c7f2545e: 'Template creation therefore failed on a missing input even without a second spend. Set the output index to 0 so the first transaction is valid and only the double spend makes template creation fail.'
result.scope_notes: A single-line unit test fix in miner_tests.
result.card: This PR corrects the double-spend test case in TestBasicMining by setting the spending transaction prevout index to 0 instead of leaving it as NULL_INDEX. Previously, the test reused a nullified transaction, causing block template creation to fail due to spending a nonexistent input rather than validating double-spend handling. This ensures the unit test actually exercises the intended double-spend failure condition.

risk.why: A mistake in unit test inputs would only cause test failures or mask miner test assertions.
